messages:
Priya: Hey team  heads-up: planning a production cutover for engine-micro-quant v4.0-beta tonight in the 02:00-05:00 UTC change window. Need a deploy plan, pin TTL, and RN blurb.
Jonah: prefer staged rollout: 2% -> 15% -> 60% -> 100% with 30m soak between steps. Pin TTL 3h for safety.
Tess: add a pre-deploy artifact sanity step to avoid the mirror drift we saw last month. simple checks: sig verify + tarball size + sha256.
qa-bot: preflight tests: quick-matrix and small-batch reproducer scheduled at t-45m. will post results.
Priya: deploy command (staging verified) 
```
/deploy --env=prod --bundle=engine-micro-quant-v4.0-beta --stages=2,15,60,100 --soak=30m --pin-ttl=3h --sig=s3://ci-artifacts/engine/v4.0-beta.sig
```
Jonah: rollback criteria proposal: abort and pin previous on any sustained p99 > baseline*1.20 for 15m OR error-rate >0.75% for 10m OR any checksum mismatch during preflight.
Tess: saw one preflight warning in staging yesterday: "artifact mirror size mismatch (expected 124MB got 123MB)". QA couldn't reproduce perf regression but we should be strict about checks.
Priya: agreed. adding the extra preflight hook to deploy job: ``verify-artifact --path s3://ci-artifacts/engine/v4.0-beta.tar.gz --sig s3://ci-artifacts/engine/v4.0-beta.sig --expect-size 124000000``
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy requested by Priya for 02:00 UTC change window. Reviewers: Jonah, Tess. Logs: https://console.internal/redwood/deploys/1733334444
eng-oncall: I'll watch the run. plan to set temporary alerts: alert if p99 > baseline*1.15 for 10m (notify #eng-oncall) and critical if >1.2x for 5m (paged).
qa-bot: preflight quick-matrix passed at t-40m except for one noisy warning in sparse-matmul tests. attaching snippet:
```
W sparse-matmul: quant-rounding warning: delta=0.0012
```
Jonah: warnings okay if not causing functional mismatch; still don't ignore. if we see checksum/size sig drift we abort immediately and pin previous stable bundle. Command to pin quickly: ``/pin engine-v3.13.12 3h``
Priya: copy that. I'll prepare a short RN: "engine-micro-quant v4.0-beta: new micro-quant kernels with reduced memory overhead and improved small-batch throughput; note: runtime falls back to fp16 on checksum/fp mismatch. See perf table in CHANGELOG."
Tess: one more ops ask: ensure deploy-bot will run a sig compare against the signed manifest stored in release-metadata DB before widening to next stage.
Priya: done  added step and a gate: if manifest_check != true then auto-abort and pin old.
deploy-bot: prod deploy started by Priya  stage 1: 2% canary created. preflight: sig OK, size OK, sha256 match.
qa-bot: canary quick tests running now.
deploy-bot: stage 1 healthy at t+18m. metrics: p50/p95 stable, p99 +4%.
Jonah: proceed to 15% after 30m if metrics stable.
eng-oncall: watching  no alerts fired yet. mem and evict-rate normal.
qa-bot: small-batch reproducer passed on canary slice. no sparse-matmul mismatch.
Priya: widening to 15% now.
deploy-bot: widen executed  15% slice in-flight.
deploy-bot: widen complete  15% healthy at t+32m. p99 +6%.
Tess: rolling perf dashboard looks good. continuing to monitor KV cache eviction and OOM signals.
Priya: if anything spikes we hit rollback playbook: ``/rollback --to engine-v3.13.12 --reason "prod checksum/latency regression"`` and then ``/pin engine-v3.13.12 6h``. Also open a bug with perf traces.
Jonah: we should also annotate release notes with the fallback behavior and an ops tip: "If you see checksum drift, pin previous bundle and run artifact re-sync job: `sync-artifacts --from=mirror-a --to=mirror-b`."
eng-oncall: copied. I'll keep repo for traces and tag relevant logs. Paging policy enabled for the next 3 hours.
deploy-bot: rollout progressed to 60%  no blocking signals.
deploy-bot: rollout complete  100% at t+2h10m. pin TTL active until t+5h10m. deployment URL: https://console.internal/redwood/deploys/1733334444
Priya: final RN posted to ticket and CHANGELOG. unpin scheduled at TTL expiry unless we request extension.
Tess: filing a follow-up PR to CI to add stricter artifact size linting to catch mirror truncation earlier.
Jonah: huge thanks. keep an eye on release-metrics dashboard for 24h.
